Name: EQUIP_PARAM_ACCESSORY_ST
Description: Accessory items: SpEffects applied while equipped, equip group, prices and inventory flags. Carried over from earlier FromSoftware games; likely unused in AC6.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the network test build.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the retail build.

Fields.Name: Reference ID
Fields.Description: ID called by this accessory. What it points to is set by Reference Type.

Fields.Name: Particle Variation ID
Fields.Description: Specify SFX variation (used to identify SFX in combination with TimeActEditor ID)

Fields.Name: Weight
Fields.Description: Weight. In kilograms.

Fields.Name: Behavior ID
Fields.Description: Behaviour ID (skill).

Fields.Name: Base Price
Fields.Description: Basic price

Fields.Name: Sell Value
Fields.Description: Price received when selling the item.

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: The ordering within the menu.

Fields.Name: QWC ID
Fields.Description: The ID this item uses for world tendency.

Fields.Name: Model ID
Fields.Description: Equipment model number

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Menu icon ID

Fields.Name: Shop Level
Fields.Description: Shop level at which the item can be sold in a shop.

Fields.Name: Achievement ID
Fields.Description: The achievement ID this part is associated with, if any.

Fields.Name: Sequential Achievement ID
Fields.Description: The sequential achievement ID this part is associated with, if any.

Fields.Name: Model Category
Fields.Description: Equipment model type

Fields.Name: Model Gender
Fields.Description: Gender of equipment model

Fields.Name: Accessory Category
Fields.Description: Accessory category.

Fields.Name: Reference Type
Fields.Description: Category of Reference ID: attack, projectile or SpEffect.

Fields.Name: SpEffect Category
Fields.Description: Category used so that effects which change parameters per action type (for example "boost weapon attacks only") can apply to this item. Set None where no category is needed.

Fields.Name: Vagrant Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: -1: No vagrant 0: No lottery 1 ~: With lottery

Fields.Name: Vagrant Bonus Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: -1: No drop 0: No lottery 1 ~: With lottery

Fields.Name: Vagrant Enemy Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: -1: No drop 0: No lottery 1 ~: With lottery

Fields.Name: Is Depositable
Fields.Description: Can be put in storage.

Fields.Name: Destroy on Unequip
Fields.Description: Is destroyed when unequipped.

Fields.Name: Block Drop in Multiplayer
Fields.Description: Block the ability to drop in multiplayer sessions.

Fields.Name: Is Discardable
Fields.Description: Can be discarded.

Fields.Name: Is Droppable
Fields.Description: Can be dropped.

Fields.Name: Shop Price
Fields.Description: Price when bought from a shop.

Fields.Name: Accessory Group
Fields.Description: Items of the same group cannot be equipped at the same time

Fields.Name: Pledge Type
Fields.Description: The pledge type that can use this accessory.

Fields.Name: Completion Achievement ID
Fields.Description: SEQ number of the completion-type achievement this item counts towards.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: 1
Fields.Description: Resident SpEffect applied while the accessory is equipped.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: 2
Fields.Description: Resident SpEffect applied while the accessory is equipped.

Fields.Description: Resident SpEffect applied while the accessory is equipped.

Fields.Description: Resident SpEffect applied while the accessory is equipped.
